  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "THE {{ing_01|CEREAL}} IS SOAKED; {{ing_02|CHICKPEAS}}, {{ing_03|LENTILS}} AND {{ing_04|PEAS}} ARE CRUSHED AND BOILED WITH IT;"
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "WHEN WELL COOKED, ADD PLENTY OF {{ing_05|OIL}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "NOW CUT {{ing_06|GREEN HERBS}}, {{ing_07|LEEKS}}, {{ing_08|CORIANDER}}, {{ing_09|DILL}}, {{ing_10|FENNEL}}, {{ing_11|BEETS}}, {{ing_12|MALLOWS}}, {{ing_13|CABBAGE STRUNKS}}, ALL SOFT AND GREEN AND FINELY CUT, AND PUT IN A POT."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "THE {{ing_13|CABBAGE}} COOK [separately. Also]"
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "CRUSH {{ing_14|FENNEL SEED}}, {{ing_15|ORIGANY}}, {{ing_16|SYLPHIUM}} AND {{ing_17|LOVAGE}}, AND WHEN CRUSHED, ADD {{ing_18|BROTH}} TO TASTE,"
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "POUR THIS OVER THE PORRIDGE, STIR IT TOGETHER AND USE SOME {{ing_19|FINELY CHOPPED CABBAGE STEMS}} TO SPRINKLE ON TOP."
    }
  ],
